text.content:
Hotels with no guests, and the people who built them and never got paid.

Region: Pacifica (district O). Was: Pacifica Playground
Controlled by: The Voodoo Boys, quietly; the NCPD holds Precinct 9 like a fortress
The feel of it: Clean water, pirate power and a pirate net in a dead resort
Notable locations: Batty's Hotel (#48), the Grand Imperial Mall, NCPD Precinct 9, Radio Lakay
Danger: Combat. SC 2 (NCPD Precinct 9, holding, Medium). UC 8

The north end of the resort, where the Pacifica Bridge comes in. The Haitian community lives here, refugees from the 2062 storm and their kids, who poured the resort's concrete, with stranded construction crews from everywhere and squatters in the hotel rooms. Coastview has more people than the Council admits and fewer than it needs. The Council is debating cutting services; Agwe is already organizing to survive without them.

Places

  • NCPD Precinct 9. SC 8 inside, 2 outside. Sandbags, generators, twelve tired cops, and a sergeant who refuses to leave.
  • Radio Lakay. SC 3. A pirate station on the top floor of a dead hotel: Haitian music, news the networks won't run, and coded messages.

Getting There

NCART: Pacifica North, Coastview, Grand Imperial (Pacifica Line, suspended).

Turf

Voodoo Boys.

People

  • "Agwe" (Netrunner 10, Voodoo Boys).
  • Batty (Fixer 5). Owner of Batty's Hotel.
  • Sergeant Odile Bastien (Solo 6, NCPD). Commands Precinct 9.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.12
